fields.System.Title: INB-304 — Override the suggested location with a reason
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a putaway operator, I want to put stock somewhere other than the suggestion when
reality differs, so that the record matches where the stock actually is.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a suggested destination, when I scan a different location, then I must
  • choose a specific reason code.
  • - Given an override, then the destination is still validated against every rule — an
  • override is not a bypass.
  • - Given the reason codes, then they are specific: suggestion full, suggestion blocked,
  • physically unreachable, consolidating with existing stock, operator judgement.
  • - Given overrides over time, then they are reportable by reason and by suggested
  • location.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound |
| Tables | putaway_task |
| Risks | Reasons all defaulting to "other", losing the signal ([doc 05 WF 3](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
